# Artefact index (generated by scripts/make_artifacts.py)

All numbers are SYNTHETIC-workload results. C3 (CartPole) was not met for the dueling+Double architecture.

## Produced

* T1_baseline_inventory: T1 - baseline inventory
* T3_head_to_head: T3 - head-to-head statistics (post-hoc family, Addendum S1)
* T4_headroom: T4 - headroom
* T5_overhead: T5 - overhead (measured on this PC)
* F1_miss_ratio_curves.png: baselines at every capacity present; learned agents only at 1/5/25%
* F3_iqm_intervals.png, F4_performance_profiles.png, F5_probability_of_improvement.png, F6_boxplots.png (rliable-style, dU vs random)
* T2_harsh_cap*.md/csv and F2_pareto_harsh.png (results/, scripts/make_f2_t2.py)
* T7_adaptation.txt + F7_adaptation.png (scripts/shift_report.py)

## NOT produced (and why)

* **T6** - metadata-charged re-run of T2 (R-E8) - not run
* **T8** - ablation ladder S0-S5 and arms A-D (R-E9) - out of scope of Addendum M11-E
* **T9** - simulation-vs-deployment agreement - needs the Redis demo (deferred)
* **F8** - latency CDF from a deployment - needs the Redis demo (deferred)
* **F9** - tier-ratio sensitivity - not run
* **F10** - predictor-degradation curve - not run beyond the M7 signal test
* **F11** - training curves - not saved by the evaluation runs (appendix item)
